findings.issue: pt gloss for いい is 'bem' plus a parenthetical about よくない ('não é bom') copied from another sentence. Here いい is the attributive adjective modifying 仕事 and means 'bom'; the よくない note is false for this sentence and inverts the sense.
findings.current: bem (forma de いい/よい em よくない = não é bom)

findings.issue: 何の話してる is 何の話(を)してる — noun 話 + する; 何の must modify a noun (*何の + verb 話す is ungrammatical). Standard reading is なんのはなししてるの; the kana drops the し of する (auto-parser treated 話し as the verb 話す).
findings.current: 「なんのはなしてるの?」「わかってるくせに」
findings.suggested: 「なんのはなししてるの?」「わかってるくせに」

findings.issue: Token 話し is analyzed as the verb 話す ('to talk') in stem form before てる, but the structure is 何の話(を)してる: noun 話 'talk/topic' + する→してる. Gloss, note and segmentation all follow the wrong parse (this is also the source of the kana error).
findings.suggested: talk, topic (noun; 何の話 = 'what topic', followed by する → してる)

findings.issue: Same missing syllable as the kana: 何の話してる reads nan no hanashi shiteru (noun 話 + する), so romaji should contain 'hanashishiteru', not 'hanashiteru'.
Token list is corrupted: two spurious tokens 幾(いく) and つ(つ) are prepended before 弟, duplicating the later 幾つ token; the concatenated tokens no longer reconstruct the sentence 弟さんって、お幾つですか？
findings.current: tokens[0]=幾(いく), tokens[1]=つ(つ) inserted before 弟
findings.suggested: Remove tokens[0]-[1]; token list should be 弟/さん/って/、/お/幾つ/です/か/？

findings.issue: lit_en addresses the brother directly ('how old are you?'), but the sentence asks the listener about the brother's age (3rd person), as en, pt and lit_pt ('quanto(s) é?') correctly render.
findings.current: Little brother (-san), how old are you?
findings.suggested: As for (your) younger brother(-san), how old (is he)?

findings.issue: ない in １つしかない is the negative existential predicate (negation of ある, an i-adjective) and the main predicate of the sentence, not an auxiliary attached to a verb; the role 'auxiliar de negação' contradicts the token's own gloss 'não há / não existe'.
findings.current: auxiliar de negação (parte de しか〜ない)
findings.suggested: predicado existencial negativo ('não há'; nega ある, completa しか〜ない)

findings.issue: Note calls 与え the 'forma conjuntiva' (連用形) used as base for passive られる; られる attaches to the irrealis stem (未然形) — identical in shape for ichidan verbs, but the base name is wrong (cf. 言わ correctly labeled 'raiz irrealis' in sent:tatoeba-104331).
findings.current: raiz de 与える em forma conjuntiva, base para anexar a passiva られる
findings.suggested: raiz de 与える na forma irrealis (未然形), base para anexar a passiva られる
